argument.root_pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)},
  StructuralIgnorance.vcBounded 𝒜 1 → StructuralIgnorance.HasKernelScheme 𝒜 1

leaves.doc:
A reconstruction rule: from a kept labeled pair — kernel points and their
1-labeled part — to a total hypothesis. Total by convention; only values on
realizable pairs matter.

A kernel scheme of size `k` with no side information: one reconstruction rule
under which every realizable sample contains a generating kernel of at most `k`
points (Littlestone–Warmuth 1986, in compression-map-free form).
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq α] → Set (Set α) → ℕ → Prop

leaves.doc:
`ρ` regenerates the sample `(A, T)` from the kernel `Z`: the kernel is kept
inside the sample, has at most `k` points, and the reconstructed hypothesis meets
`A` in exactly `T`.
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq α] → StructuralIgnorance.Convention α → ℕ → Finset α → Finset α → Finset α → Prop

leaves.doc:
The labeled window `(A, T)` is realizable in `𝒜`: some member meets `A` in
exactly `T`. Points of `T` are labeled 1, points of `A \ T` are labeled 0
(Littlestone–Warmuth 1986, realizable samples).
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → Set (Set α) → Finset α → Finset α → Prop

leaves.doc:
The class `𝒜` shatters the finite set `B`: every sub-pattern of `B` is realized
by a member. `Set`-grammar port of `Finset.Shatters` (Mathlib
`Combinatorics.SetFamily.Shatter`).
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → Set (Set α) → Finset α → Prop

leaves.doc: The part of a finite window lying in the base set.
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → Set α → Finset α → Finset α

leaves.doc:
Reconstruction by intersection: the hypothesis is the intersection of all
members containing the kernel's 1-labeled part. Improper — the output need not
be a member — which is what dense chains require; the kernel's point set is not
consulted beyond its labels.
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → Set (Set α) → StructuralIgnorance.Convention α

leaves.doc:
The membership order of a class: `a` lies below `b` when every member
containing `b` contains `a`.
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → Set (Set α) → α → α → Prop

leaves.doc: The class relabeled by symmetric difference with a base set.
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → Set (Set α) → Set α → Set (Set α)

leaves.doc:
The conjugated convention: untwist the kernel's labels, reconstruct in the
twisted class, twist the hypothesis back.
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq α] → Set α → StructuralIgnorance.Convention α → StructuralIgnorance.Convention α

leaves.doc:
VC bound in `Set` grammar: no shattered set exceeds `d` points (the port of
`Finset.vcDim ≤ d`, Mathlib `Combinatorics.SetFamily.Shatter`).
leaves.pretty: {α : Type u_1} → Set (Set α) → ℕ → Prop

nodes.doc:
**d = 1 universality: every VC-1 class compresses at kernel size one, with
no side information.** No finiteness, no distinguished member, no chain
hypothesis. Twist the class by any member to place `∅` in it; there the VC
bound makes co-member points comparable in the membership order, so every label
set is a finite chain; anchor at its maximum, reconstruct with
`interConvention`, and transport the scheme back with the same kernels.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)},
  StructuralIgnorance.vcBounded 𝒜 1 → StructuralIgnorance.HasKernelScheme 𝒜 1

nodes.doc: VC bounds are twist-invariant (the direction needed for normalization).
nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {d : ℕ},
  StructuralIgnorance.vcBounded 𝒜 d →
    ∀ (S₀ : Set α), StructuralIgnorance.vcBounded (StructuralIgnorance.twistClass 𝒜 S₀) d

nodes.doc:
Shattering transports from the twisted class back to the original: the
witnesses untwist, and the patterns correspond through the involution
`C ↦ C ∆ (B ∩ S₀)`.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {S₀ : Set α} {B : Finset α},
  StructuralIgnorance.SetShatters (StructuralIgnorance.twistClass 𝒜 S₀) B → StructuralIgnorance.SetShatters 𝒜 B

nodes.doc:
With the empty set in the class, a VC bound of one makes any two points of a
common member comparable in the membership order: otherwise the four assembled
patterns shatter the pair.

hypotheses.name: hab
hypotheses.pretty: ∃ S ∈ 𝒜, a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S

nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)},
  StructuralIgnorance.vcBounded 𝒜 1 →
    ∅ ∈ 𝒜 →
      ∀ {a b : α}, (∃ S ∈ 𝒜, a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S) → StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a b ∨ StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 b a

nodes.doc:
The anchor leg of the intersection convention: a maximum of the label set in
the membership order is a size-1 kernel. The upper inclusion comes from the
realizing member, the lower from maximality.

hypotheses.name: hmax
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ a ∈ T, StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a x

nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {A T : Finset α},
  StructuralIgnorance.IsSample 𝒜 A T →
    ∀ {x : α},
      x ∈ T →
        (∀ a ∈ T, StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a x) →
          StructuralIgnorance.IsKernel (StructuralIgnorance.interConvention 𝒜) 1 A T {x}

nodes.doc: Realizable label patterns are supported inside their window.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {A T : Finset α}, StructuralIgnorance.IsSample 𝒜 A T → T ⊆ A

nodes.doc: A finite nonempty set on which the membership order is total has a maximum.

hypotheses.name: htot
hypotheses.pretty: ∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a b ∨ StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 b a

nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {T : Finset α},
  (∀ a ∈ T, ∀ b ∈ T, StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a b ∨ StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 b a) →
    T.Nonempty → ∃ x ∈ T, ∀ a ∈ T, StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a x

∀ {α : Type u_1} {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {a b c : α},
  StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a b → StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 b c → StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a c
∀ {α : Type u_1} (𝒜 : Set (Set α)) (a : α), StructuralIgnorance.memOrder 𝒜 a a

nodes.doc: Twisting by a member places the empty set in the class.
nodes.pretty: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {S₀ : Set α}, S₀ ∈ 𝒜 → ∅ ∈ StructuralIgnorance.twistClass 𝒜 S₀

nodes.doc: Kernel schemes transport back through a twist, with the same kernels.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {S₀ : Set α} {k : ℕ},
  StructuralIgnorance.HasKernelScheme (StructuralIgnorance.twistClass 𝒜 S₀) k → StructuralIgnorance.HasKernelScheme 𝒜 k
∀ {α : Type u_1} (s t u : Set α), symmDiff s t ∩ u = symmDiff (s ∩ u) (t ∩ u)
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] (Z T F : Finset α), Z ∩ symmDiff T F = symmDiff (Z ∩ T) (Z ∩ F)

nodes.doc:
Realizability transports through the twist, with the label set twisted
inside the window.
nodes.pretty:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {𝒜 : Set (Set α)} {A T : Finset α},
  StructuralIgnorance.IsSample 𝒜 A T →
    ∀ (S₀ : Set α),
      StructuralIgnorance.IsSample (StructuralIgnorance.twistClass 𝒜 S₀) A
        (symmDiff T (StructuralIgnorance.baseLabels S₀ A))
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S₀ : Set α) (Z : Finset α), ↑(StructuralIgnorance.baseLabels S₀ Z) = ↑Z ∩ S₀
